idea-plugin.name: C# File Type Icons
idea-plugin.description:
Shows a different icon for each C# file in Rider, depending on the type it declares, the same way IntelliJ IDEA does for Java files.

No more rows of identical .cs icons: you can tell classes, interfaces and enums apart at a glance.

What it recognizes

  • Classes, abstract classes, interfaces, enums, structs, records and delegates
  • Exceptions, attributes and controllers (detected by name or base type)
  • DTOs, entities, models and services (detected by name suffix)
  • Files with several top-level types
  • Entry points such as Program.cs, and GlobalUsings.cs files

Markers

Icons get small overlay markers for static and sealed classes, test classes (NUnit, MSTest, xUnit) and classes that contain Main.

How it works

The plugin reads the beginning of each file and detects the declared type with lightweight text analysis, without running a full code analysis, so it stays fast. Rare edge cases may get a generic class icon.
